3. The paper demonstrates an adequate understanding of the relevant literature in the field.
However, I have seen that no hypotheses are mentioned, so it is better to mention the hypotheses
and show the reader that you have tested them.

Dear reviewer, 
Thank you very much for dedicating your time and effort to reviewing our work, particularly
for your prompt review report. Your insightful comments will undoubtedly enhance the
quality of our manuscript. We have taken your comments to heart and will carefully address
each of the five main points you raised in the revised version of this article. We look forward
to your thoughts on the revisions we have made.

Response: Thank you for this significant comment. We updated the literature review with
the most recent studies and segmented it to focus on the key variables: (i) financial inclusion
and banking stability, (ii) non-linear relationship between financial inclusion and bank
stability, (iii) the moderating effects of macro-prudential regulation. This restructuring
allows for clearer hypothesis formulation and empirical relevance.
